prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Two female friends aged 28 and 34 walk shoulder to shoulder along a quiet tree-lined city path, turning toward one another mid-conversation and laughing softly. They wear ordinary light jackets in muted warm colours. Use a candid three-quarter view, gentle spring afternoon light, and an unbranded urban background with space around their upper bodies. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances: the 28-year-old woman has a short copper-red bob, freckles and a slim build; the 34-year-old has straight black hair tied in a loose low ponytail, olive skin and a curvy build. They have clearly different facial structures and smiles.
Composition priority: exact 4:5 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
Critical optical realism: one uninterrupted photograph, no gradient mask, artificial vignette band, crossfade, dissolve, compositing, double exposure or fading of bodies into pavement. Photograph the friends from their knees upward; their coats and trousers continue naturally through the bottom image edge. Interpret the quiet lower region as low-detail clothing, never as erased bodies or a synthetic blurred strip.
review: Reviewed replacement full vertical image: two distinct female friends walk on a spring path, one copper-bobbed and freckled, one dark-haired with a low ponytail. Faces, visible hands and bag straps are coherent; coats and trousers continue naturally to the image edge. No dissolving bodies or synthetic horizontal blend remains. Vertical 1122x1402.
